note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. Times are fictional labels. The substitution changes one supplied time label only; the stations keep the supplied order and the cards keep their racks and holders. "Reciprocal" and "unilateral" are supplied configurations only; nothing is concluded.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional exchange: Party A commits to supply 40 oak chairs (C-101), Party B to pay for them (C-102); the story's end state; the lens enlarges the receipt stations; the time label of the receipt of B's commitment (Day 1, 11:30) is substituted by the supplied alternative (Day 1, 12:30).

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a garden-maintenance promise between different parties, supplied as a unilateral configuration (only A's commitment travels; one card, no empty place for a second); the inspected label is the receipt of A's commitment (Day 4, 12:15 → Day 5, 09:40). The station keeps its place in the supplied order.

contextLabels.context: A's commitment received; only A's is supplied
contextLabels.marker: Changed: the receipt time of A's commitment

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long names, roles, references, titles, time labels and context labels, three terms and all four events; the long time label of the receipt of B's commitment is substituted by a long alternative.
